prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Customization: Move sign-in screen to after pet adoption choices so users experience pet creation before signing up. (why: Sign-in drop-off is 72.9% occurring early before users build emotional attachment to their chosen pet.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Screen: Insert an interactive tutorial screen teaching shortcut keys, system tray controls, and pet hide/reveal commands. (why: Support mailbox received multiple complaints (3 emails) regarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after setup.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Customization Quality Verification Flow: Add an interactive photo validation preview panel to verify lighting and resolution before custom pet rendering. (why: Support mailbox received 3 bug reports stating custom pet generation fails or results look wrong.)
3: [home, wait_info] Interactive Waiting Screen with Time Estimate: Show progress bar, estimated rendering time, and desktop feature tips during the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step (home target) suffers high friction with median 201s and mean 2336s duration.)
4: [finish, hint] Tray & Visibility Recovery Hint on Home Intro: Add clear hint box explaining how to unhide pet if it does not appear on screen immediately. (why: 3 support messages reported pet not showing on desktop or app not opening post-onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Story Screen with Quick Time Estimate: Rewrite story copy to highlight 2-minute quick setup and display total time estimate. (why: choose_path mean time is high (514s), causing 23.8% drop-off right at the start.)
6: [home, notification] Ready Notification Alert on Waiting Screen: Enable desktop notification switch on waiting screen so users know when setup finishes. (why: Mean duration on waiting screen is extremely long (2336s), indicating users alt-tab away and forget.)
